thread:
jen: Quick heads-up — we need a minimal hotfix for a KV-cache timeout regression. PR #4821 contains the fix. Target version 2.6.4, cutoff in ~60m. Need: cherry-pick to release/2.6, changelog line, smoke in staging, and a short rollback plan. Who can own cutover? :rotating_light:

alex: I'll lead cutover. will open hotfix branch + PR for the cherry-pick and ping reviewers.

alex: quick question — which commit to cherry-pick?

jen: use `abcdef1` (short sha) from PR #4821.

alex: copying the commands i'll run:
```
git fetch origin release/2.6
git checkout -b hotfix/kvcache-2.6.4 origin/release/2.6
git cherry-pick abcdef1
# update changelog/CHANGELOG.md with one-liner
git push origin hotfix/kvcache-2.6.4
```

maya: on review, can do a fast pass once the hotfix PR is up. :eyes: 

sam: QA available — can run staging smoke in ~25m. what endpoints to test?

alex: smoke list: /generate, /kv/get, s3 proxy, and CPU/latency dashboards. i'll paste a curl for kv test.

alex: curl for kv test:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/kv/get -d '{"key":"test-kv-timeout"}'
```

tj: tagging ops-oncall for deployment window. @ops-oncall can you stand by for the push and brief rollout? :+1:

ops-oncall: yep, available. will monitor infra and pre-warm instances. set health-check timeout at 120s for this rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy job created — build/8922 -> staging -> canary -> prod. link: https://deploy.redwood.ai/builds/8922 :rocket: 

alex: when can we cut canary? after staging smoke pass and maya + sam signoff. i'll aim for canary in ~40m.

maya: approved on code, left one tiny comment (nonblocking).

sam: staging smoke green. memory and p95 look normal. :white_check_mark: 

alex: starting canary now. will route 5% traffic for 10m, then 50%, then full.

ops-oncall: monitoring dashboards look fine for first 6m. no error spike.

alex: canary -> 50% now.

ops-oncall: slight uptick in 504s on a single AZ, rolling restart of that AZ's instances helped. back to baseline.

alex: promoting to 100%. tagging release note: "Fix KV cache timeout causing intermittent evictions under high seq-length load."

jen: thanks all. changelog entry pushed by alex. final version bumped to 2.6.4 in package and docker tags.

alex: cutover done, will keep eyes on tokencost and latency metrics for 2h. if regressions, revert with `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` and deploy rollback build 8919.

deploy-bot: prod deploy 8922 completed at 2154330450. :tada: 

alex: closing thread — no further action unless alerts surface. cheers.
